notes.title: Fighter Creator 4.5 Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Wanted to have this update available before the end of this month but, forgot to include character AI for the base project so, just a few more days. 

Sorry for the extremely long wait for this update, just trying to make sure I get almost everything you will need to get started.

There are still a few more things I want to add to the editor but those will be included shortly after the release of this update, since those features are not neccesary for the editor to function properly.

notes.title: Fighter Creator 4.5 - The Next Update
notes.notes:
[h1]REDESIGNED INTERFACE[/h1]

Unnecessary windows and clutter have been removed to give the editor a cleaner look and, speed up the development process :

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/158491d5f62eedfce7a80ecc17f0c60d82278545.jpg[/img]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/bae7b870742b05c294d6f9c2c1505a6b20a3f649.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/c8ec56fe3da39b74ce618f462ef2744cf882b448.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/2bf372da8e085c51c5d57abd5dd8a07799db1189.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/4c7b31c43af68e7d2dee9bd79d634bc6ff42909e.jpg[/img][/url][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/20a5562234efcbf84aa6c6e0f0cf48d6c7a400bf.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/26afe70f2a6d75520b4cc33d14a320ccec4207ed.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]DATA EDITING IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

When editing data items, a smaller menu will fade in allowing users to make quick edits to one or more data items at the same time. Buttons for adding folders, new data items, as well as cutting, copying, pasting, and deleting will be accessible next to the data item :

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/39cccf239b7dce8aeb5e18945e375eedd1bc13cf.jpg[/img]
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/fff20acff4009f80a364d7999e2ab0aa2822e280.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/e256e568dd5ff6b4f19394f9bde286c19a3c3997.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]SCRIPTING IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

Frames for script can now be typed in, significantly speeding up the scripting process, and features an auto updating side window to help you understand what needs to be placed in your frame in order for it to function correctly :

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/764dd2da322c46de0a1c59bb531d02bf659bcae0.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/f4219eeca7f47a5154fe2157e7a4d8bfcab3a685.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/8f2260c28e5e4de29271f60e0e81a7be118d4bdb.jpg[/img]

[h1]BASE PROJECT AND RESOURCES[/h1]

Every project/resource created in this version of Fighter Creator will start off with everything, besides media, needed to have a playable game up and running. All you will need to do is import your own media and then expand on what has already been provided :

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30079330/d573c5ebaafd441f1f17e6182bc45448b7205195.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Details of the next major update coming soon.
Details of the next major update coming soon.
Update #2 | Major Editor Changes | Base Project
notes.notes:
[h1]Major Editor Changes[/h1]

Working on a functionality overhaul for the editor. Going to be removing a lot of the extra clicks and dialogs you have to go through to create and edit resources.

Scripting will now be using a text format instead to speed up the process, but will still be simple to use.

Will also be improving performance and adding more settings to tweak multiple aspects of the editor.

[h1]Base Project[/h1]

Is almost ready to go and will feature just about everything you should need, except media, to start working with Fighter Creator.

[b]Resources included[/b]
[list]
   [*]Menus  -  Title Screen, Character/Stage Select, Options Menu, Game HUD, and Loading Screen.
   [*]A Stage.
   [*]A Character.
   [*]Game Modes  -  Versus and Practice modes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1 | Next Update Details
notes.notes:
[h1]Update - 4.3.10.8.3.17[/h1]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
   [*]Zooming into Example images
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
   [*]Editor text/font resolution
   [*]Accessing the manual
   [*]Scripting issues
[/list]

[h1]Next Update[/h1]

[b]Project and Resource defaults[/b]

Already knew some people would have trouble getting things going with the engine, as it is a fairly new design, but I have been working on defaults for projects and resources that will definitely help out.

So basically when you create a new project, It will already have a set of buttons, controllers, reactions, save files, and resources created. So all you would have to do is import your sprites and a basic game will be playable. If you have ever used MUGEN, the base game you start off with is a good example of what I'm bringing to Fighter Creator, and you will still be able to completely modify everything.
